differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease secondary to metastatic prostate cancer
differential.rationale: Common in advanced malignancy and explains normocytic anemia with normal iron studies (not provided) and low MPV.

differential.name: Iron‑deficiency anemia from occult gastrointestinal bleeding
differential.rationale: Age, chronic NSAID use for osteoarthritis, and tobacco use raise risk of GI blood loss causing microcytic anemia.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: History of myocardial infarction and possible undetected renal impairment (creatinine not shown) can reduce erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Elderly patient with anemia, low platelet MPV and multiple comorbidities raises concern for marrow dysplasia.

differential.name: Hemolytic anemia (e.g., autoimmune)
differential.rationale: Less likely but considered given unexplained anemia; would be supported by elevated LDH, bilirubin, or reticulocytosis if tested.
